scope: Exactly 57 named D10 source/migration/operational/dependency/reused-security/evidence-only files matched to the source scan, selected tests/contracts/release evidence, four explicitly named synthetic screenshots, selected Nombramientos runtime JavaScript and GestionChurch compiled build artifacts, and only public Nombramientos .next/static JS/CSS bundles plus their exact deployed standalone copies. Not a full application or supply-chain manifest.

publicEvidence.temporalPanClassificationScope: Raw non-PAN rules remain mandatory. Original JSON string/key/numeric lexemes are PAN-scanned before parsing can round numbers or overwrite duplicates; decoded strings/keys receive all scanner rules. Only finite, fractional, nonnegative numeric tokens no greater than 24 hours at $.testResults[i].assertionResults[j].duration are classified as timing metrics. Decoded public attachments receive no timing exemption. Original evidence bytes are unchanged by this generator.
publicEvidence.approvedPathReferenceScope: Only the exact backend summary frozen-report metadata reference and five literal public API endpoint paths at root-array records of the two named, validated public HTTP diagnostic JSON attachments in selected browser reports are accepted. No paths are opened or resolved; queries, fragments, suffixes, nested routes, other attachments/files and unknown body formats are rejected.
publicEvidence.historicalSanitizationPolicy: Distributed browser JSON declares v3 local URL query/fragment, private error-context-reference and local-user-filesystem-path redaction, preserving test outcomes/counts. Those declarations and sanitized content, including normalized public JSON attachments, are checked here; raw private originals are not read or independently compared by this generator.

localReadiness.residualScope: Unregistered UUID tenant databases have unknown ownership unless an exact owned receipt proves otherwise. A nonzero count is a review flag, not authorization for deletion or a claim that this run left fixtures.
limits: Own fixture cleanup verified separately in each test. This metadata count is not authorization to delete unknown resources.
Immutable synthetic control audit is deliberately retained.
Local readiness does not certify production infrastructure or providers.

historicalEvidencePolicy: Prior cuts, including real failures, are preserved and hashed as historical evidence. They are not reclassified as current passing tests. Suite totals overlap and must not be added together.
finalDisposition: Scoped technical gates verified; metadata review remains uncleared. Unknown-owner resources are preserved without deletion authority. This is not full-production approval.
limitations: Local agent review, not independent external penetration testing.
Does not replace physical Android/iPhone, human ES/EN/FR review or independent security review.
Does not hash runtime secrets, credentials, authenticated HTML, databases, original church business content, Git history or all dependencies.
Read-only cleanup verifies owned residual metadata and declared audit retention, not original audit-chain integrity.
GestionChurch gateway runs the named TypeScript source with tsx; its three selected dist JavaScript files are compiled build artifacts, not evidence of files served by that process.
Selected runtime/build files and public bundles are hashed, not the complete deployment or supply chain; no reproducible source-to-binary build assertion is made.
A passing scoped manifest does not certify completion of the entire enterprise prompt.
